text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only a few days remained until the Oka 
Sho. Gran Alegria was entering her final 
adjustments as well.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Um, for the next rep, can I delay the 
timing of my acceleration even more?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I really want to get a feel for 
accelerating to top speed in the shortest 
time right from the steepest part of the 
hill.

text_block_list.name: Ash-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, this is max-level brutal. Well, to be 
fair... Hanshin's slope really is nasty.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
If she gets boxed in and her move is 
delayed, she'll have no other choice.

text_block_list.name: Pink-Lipped Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Still, that might be pretty common in 
sprints and miles. Accelerating on the 
uphill.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Right! What do you think, Trainer-san?
choice_data_list:
OK, but don't push yourself too hard out 
there.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yay♪

text_block_list.name: Pink-Lipped Umamusume
text_block_list.text: “—Trainer! May I try it out as well?!”

text_block_list.name: Former Mile King Trainer
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. If picking up momentum feels 
difficult, it just means it isn't suited 
for you.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Inspiring each other alongside my 
mentor's trainees, Gran Alegria was able 
to train in a wonderful environment."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her times have shown remarkable 
improvement, raising high expectations for 
her finest run at the Oka Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo, good work! You cleaning up too, 
Love-chan?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
No, I just came to get the cones. You're 
heading in already, Gran-chan?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Until the actual "Oka Sho," I'm just 
taking it easy.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I wanted to run in the Oka Sho too. If 
I hadn't tripped up with an injury, right 
about now...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...The frustration won't go away, but... 
I'm betting everything on the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So…… Our showdown will have to wait, 
Gran-chan♡

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
! You're right! Let's fight—on the 
greatest stage!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the "Oka Sho" had finally 
arrived. However, what electrified Hanshin 
Racecourse first was—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Loves Only You pulls away from the pack! 
Two lengths, three lengths... A decisive 
victory!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the 9th race, the Wasurenagusa Sho, 
Loves Only You claimed victory with a 
commanding performance.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... Ehehe, I did it! How was that, 
everyone?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's your turn. Show me a run worthy 
of the Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yay, Love-chan won!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
A 0.0045-mile lead, huh? In that case, I 
want to pull even further ahead!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm aiming to surpass Ai-senpai, so 
that much of a gap is only natural♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, I can't wait for post time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the Oka Sho, even dear friends become 
rivals. Yet, Gran Alegria was acting 
completely normal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's good that she's relaxed, but... could 
she perhaps be carrying the mood a bit too 
far?
choice_data_list: ...Are you sure you don't need to skip?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! Good job 15 Miles, 
Trainer☆

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm-hm, hmm~♪

"...Before a race, 'Skip whenever you're 
itching to run.'"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
In races where she follows this personal 
rule, Gran-chan's rate of running well is 
89%...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Compared to normal times, performance has 
increased significantly. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
She is expected to be my greatest threat 
today.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, analyzing hard as always today, 
Chrono-chan!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The Oka Sho is a mile race... It 
would be reckless to challenge Gran-chan 
empty-handed.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're right!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
However... just as she said the mile is 
her main battleground, Gran-chan's data 
was quite abundant, so...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I have studied thoroughly and prepared 
counter-strategies.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. Then I'll just have to run a 
race that blows that out of the water!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I don't call myself a mile genius for 
nothing, you know?
